title: Scarlet Byrne/Quotes
summary:
"Kathy isn't exactly part of the... family business."
- Scarlet Byrne to Zhalia Moon, (Home Turf)

"So the legends are true. Even with what I know as a Seeker it's hard to believe."
- Scarlet Byrne to Dante Vale, (Home Turf)

"I wanted to say that it's been really great working with you."
- Scarlet Byrne to Dante Vale, (Home Turf)
